verdict.rationale: Kick's docs confirm a double-entry ledger in which every synced bank, payroll, or bill transaction automatically generates a journal entry with a debit and a credit. Nothing in the pack shows an accountant manually creating and posting a journal entry, balance enforcement, or memo fields on entries. Auto-generated entries and transaction notes are adjacent features, not the manual journal-entry capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos
